summary_zh: 本页为绘本标题页，展示“空城计”三个大字及一位古代人物形象，该人物身着青色长袍，头戴黑色冠帽，右手抬起指向天空，表情自信，似乎在讲述或谋划计策。

page_text_ocr_zh: 春秋时期，楚文王去世，他的弟弟熊子元夺取了楚国的大权。熊子元在王宫里修建了一座高大华丽的宫殿，每天让人奏乐、跳万舞，从早到晚一刻也不停。宫中的人悄悄地说：‘跳万舞是为了演习战法，熊子元却只敢当成舞蹈来欣赏，我看他是没有胆量上阵杀敌的！’
page_text_en: In the Spring and Autumn period, after King Wen of Chu died, his younger brother Xiong Ziyuan seized power in the State of Chu. Xiong Ziyuan built a tall and magnificent palace in the royal palace, and every day he had music played and the Wan dance performed, without stopping from morning till night. Someone in the palace whispered: 'The Wan dance is meant to practice warfare, but Xiong Ziyuan only dares to treat it as entertainment. I think he lacks the courage to fight in battle!'
summary_zh: 本页描绘了春秋时期楚国熊子元夺取大权后，在宫中大兴土木、沉迷享乐的场景，宫中人暗中议论他缺乏胆识，无法上阵杀敌。

page_text_ocr_zh: 熊子元听说后，心想：‘看来，我得打一场胜仗，让大家知道我的厉害呀！’这一仗跟谁打呢？熊子元想了想，周边的国家，数郑国最弱。他便点了六百辆战车，率领三军浩浩荡荡地向郑国攻去。
page_text_en: After hearing this, Xiong Ziyuan thought: 'It seems I must win a battle to show everyone how formidable I am!' Who should he fight? Xiong Ziyuan thought for a moment. Among the neighboring countries, Zheng was the weakest. So he mustered six hundred war chariots and led his three armies, marching grandly toward the state of Zheng.
summary_zh: 熊子元听闻他人议论后，决心通过打仗证明自己的能力，他选择攻打最弱的郑国，并率领大军浩浩荡荡出征。

page_text_ocr_zh: 前军探路，中军由熊子元亲自指挥，后军押运粮草。这支楚军队伍有十几里长，一到郑国边界，郑军就吓得逃跑。没过多久，楚军就打到了郑国的都城。郑文公急忙召集大臣，一起想办法。
page_text_en: The vanguard scouts ahead, the main force is personally commanded by Xiong Ziyuan, and the rear force transports supplies. This Chu army, stretching for miles, reached the border of Zheng and caused the Zheng troops to flee in fear. Soon after, the Chu army reached the capital of Zheng. King Wen of Zheng hurriedly summoned his ministers to discuss a solution.
summary_zh: 楚军在熊子元率领下长驱直入，郑军溃败，楚军兵临郑国都城，郑文公紧急召集大臣商议对策。

page_text_ocr_zh:
胆小的大臣害怕地说："楚军人那么多，我们哪里打得过？赶快派人送些钱财，求他们退兵吧！"
胆大的大臣生气地吼道："送钱求饶，真没有骨气！我们要集合全国的将士，与楚国决一死战！"
还有的大臣指望救援："我们刚和齐国结盟，齐国一定会派兵来救我们的！"
page_text_en:
The timid minister said fearfully: "There are so many Chu soldiers; how could we possibly defeat them? We should quickly send some money and ask them to withdraw!"

The bold minister shouted angrily: "Giving money to beg for mercy is truly cowardly! We must gather all our soldiers and fight the Chu to the death!"

Another minister hoped for rescue: "We have just formed an alliance with Qi; Qi will surely send troops to save us!"
summary_zh: 郑国都城被楚军兵临城下，郑文公召集大臣商议对策，大臣们意见分歧：有人主张求和送钱，有人主张决一死战，还有人指望齐国救援。

page_text_ocr_zh:
只有郑文公的弟弟叔詹，一句话也没有说。
郑文公知道叔詹聪明，办法多，于是着急地
问他："是求和还是决战？叔詹，你快帮我拿个
主意吧！"叔詹想了一会儿才说："求和还是决
战，都不是好办法。坚守都城，等待救援，
倒是可以试一试。不过，
我认为不等援军赶到，楚国就会退兵。"
page_text_en:
Only Zheng Wen Gong's younger brother, Shu Zhan, said nothing.
Zheng Wen Gong knew Shu Zhan was clever and had many ideas, so he anxiously asked him: "Should we seek peace or fight to the end? Shu Zhan, please help me decide!" Shu Zhan thought for a moment and then said: "Neither seeking peace nor fighting is a good idea. We should defend the capital and wait for reinforcements. That might work. However, I believe the Chu army will retreat before the reinforcements arrive."
summary_zh: 郑文公向弟弟叔詹请教应对楚军围城的策略，叔詹提出坚守都城、等待救援，并自信地认为楚军不等援军到来就会自行退兵。

page_text_ocr_zh:
"退兵？"郑文公和大臣们都大吃一惊。
郑文公疑惑地问："熊子元亲自带兵来打郑国，怎么会退兵呢？"
叔詹胸有成竹地说："我们郑国只有两百辆战车，楚国却出动了六百辆战车来攻打，这说明熊子元害怕打败仗呀！我有一个计策，保证能让他主动退兵。"
page_text_en:
"Retreating?" King Wen of Zheng and his ministers were greatly shocked.
King Wen of Zheng asked doubtfully, "Xiong Ziyuan personally led his troops to attack Zheng. How could he retreat?"
Shu Zhan said confidently, "Our state of Zheng has only two hundred war chariots, while Chu has mobilized six hundred war chariots to attack. This shows that Xiong Ziyuan is afraid of losing! I have a plan that will surely make him retreat on his own."
summary_zh: 郑文公和大臣们对叔詹提出的楚军会主动退兵的说法感到震惊，叔詹解释称楚国兵力远超郑国，说明熊子元内心怯战，并自信地表示自己有计策能让楚军退兵。

page_text_ocr_zh:
正在这个时候，士兵气喘吁吁地跑进来报告说："楚国的前军冲破了关卡，马上就要攻进城了。"
大臣们慌得不知所措，叔詹大喊道："不要怕！"已经到了火烧眉毛的时候，无论求援还是逃跑，都来不及了。郑文公便把军队交给叔詹，让他来守城。
page_text_en:
At this moment, a soldier ran in, panting, and reported: "The vanguard of the Chu army has broken through the pass and will soon attack the city!"
The ministers were in a panic, but Shu Zhan shouted: "Don't be afraid!" It's already a matter of life and death; whether to seek help or flee, it's too late. King Wen of Zheng then handed over the army to Shu Zhan, letting him defend the city.
summary_zh: 楚军前锋逼近郑国都城，士兵紧急报告，大臣们惊慌失措，叔詹镇定指挥，郑文公将守城重任交予叔詹。

page_text_ocr_zh: 叔詹马上下令道："把城门打开，放下吊桥。百姓商贩，照常买卖。城墙上的守军，全都撤下来，退进巷子里！"当楚国的前军冲到郑国城门外时，城墙上一个郑兵都没有。城门里，卖东西的吆喝声，高高低低地传了出来。水果！新鲜的水果！卖酒！
page_text_en: Shu Zhan immediately ordered: "Open the city gate, lower the drawbridge. Civilians and merchants, continue trading as usual. The soldiers on the city walls, all withdraw and retreat into the alleys!" When the vanguard of the Chu army reached the gates of Zheng's capital, there was not a single Zheng soldier on the walls. Inside the gate, the cries of vendors echoed up and down. "Fruit! Fresh fruit!" "Selling wine!"
summary_zh: 叔詹下令打开城门、放下吊桥，让百姓照常买卖，守军撤入巷子，城内一片平静，楚军前锋抵达城下时，只见城内商贩叫卖，毫无戒备。

page_text_ocr_zh: "又细又软的葛布，便宜卖喽！" "结实光溜的大陶罐，买大送小！" "甜滋滋的大果子，又好吃又解渴！" 街上的行人来来往往，一会儿摸摸布料，一会儿挑挑罐子，馋嘴的小孩儿看见果子，口水都流出来了。
page_text_en: "Soft and fine hemp cloth, cheap sale!" "Sturdy, smooth big clay jars, buy big, get small free!" "Sweet, juicy big fruits, delicious and quenches thirst!" People on the street came and went, sometimes touching the cloth, sometimes picking out jars, while a greedy child, seeing the fruits, had saliva dripping from his mouth.
summary_zh: 郑国都城内市井繁华，商贩叫卖，百姓如常买卖，孩童流口水，城内一片平静，与城外楚军对峙形成鲜明对比。

page_text_ocr_zh: 郑国人这么悠闲，难道他们不知道，楚军就要打过来了吗？或者，他们是故意装成这样，想骗楚军进城去？前军将领起了疑心，不敢进城，就在城外扎下了营。不久，熊子元带着中军赶来了，他登上城外的高坡，望向郑国城内。
page_text_en: The people of Zheng are so leisurely. Don't they know the Chu army is about to attack? Or are they deliberately pretending like this, trying to trick the Chu army into entering the city? The vanguard commander became suspicious and dared not enter the city, so he set up camp outside the city. Soon, Xiong Ziyuan arrived with the main force. He climbed to a high hill outside the city and looked toward the city of Zheng.
summary_zh: 楚军前锋因郑国城内一片平静而心生疑虑，不敢贸然进城，在城外扎营；随后熊子元率中军抵达，登上高坡观察郑国城内情况。

page_text_ocr_zh: 太阳就要落山了，家家户户的房顶上，升起了白色的炊烟。郑国人开始做晚饭了，他们好像一点也不担心楚军的进攻！忽然，熊子元盯着城里的巷子，瞪大眼睛仔细看起来。他发现一面郑军的旗帜，随着晚风飘了起来。再看巷子深处，隐隐约约露出了银色的铠甲。啊，有伏兵！
page_text_en: The sun was about to set, and white smoke rose from the rooftops of every household. The people of Zheng were starting to cook their evening meals, seemingly not at all worried about the Chu army's attack! Suddenly, Xiong Ziyuan stared at the alleys inside the city, his eyes wide as he looked closely. He spotted a Zheng army flag fluttering in the evening breeze. Then, looking deeper into the alley, he saw the faint outline of silver armor. Ah, there are hidden troops!
summary_zh: 夕阳西下，郑国都城内炊烟袅袅，百姓如常生活，楚军主帅熊子元在城外观察时，发现巷子深处有郑军旗帜和银色铠甲，误以为有伏兵，心生警觉。

page_text_ocr_zh: 熊子元看了一会儿，叹气道："郑国这是要用假空城，骗我进去啊！如果这次我打了败仗，还有什么脸面回楚国去？快派人去探，郑国城里有多少伏兵！"过了两天，押运粮草的后军将领派人送来急报："齐国、宋国和鲁国的国君，都亲自率领大军来救郑国了。"
page_text_en: Xiong Ziyuan looked for a while and sighed, "Zheng is using a fake empty city to trick me into entering! If I lose this battle, how can I face my return to Chu? Quickly send someone to scout and find out how many hidden troops are in Zheng's city!" Two days later, a messenger from the rear army general in charge of supplies delivered an urgent report: "The rulers of Qi, Song, and Lu have personally led their armies to rescue Zheng."
summary_zh: 楚军主帅熊子元因郑国城内平静而怀疑有诈，下令探查伏兵；两天后，后军将领传来急报，称齐、宋、鲁三国国君已率军前来救援郑国，令楚军更加紧张。

page_text_ocr_zh: 熊子元再也坐不住了，急忙对将领们说：‘这几个国家是想包围我们！我们打到郑国的都城，也算是大获全胜了，赶紧撤吧！’这天夜里，楚军嘴里含着小木棒，摘下战马脖子上的铃铛，用厚厚的布巾包住马蹄，悄无声息地溜走了。
page_text_en: Xiong Ziyuan could no longer sit still. He hurriedly told his generals, 'These several countries are trying to surround us! We've reached the capital of Zheng, which is already a great victory. Let's retreat quickly!' That night, the Chu army put small sticks in their mouths, removed the bells from their warhorses' necks, wrapped the horses' hooves with thick cloths, and slipped away silently.
summary_zh: 楚军主帅熊子元因担心被齐、宋、鲁三国联军包围，决定撤军。当晚，楚军悄无声息地撤离郑国都城，用木棒含在嘴里、包住马蹄、摘下铃铛以避免发出声响。

page_text_ocr_zh: 第二天，郑文公和大臣们来到城墙上，只见楚军军营帐扎得稳稳当当，战旗呼啦啦迎风飘扬，他们吓得大叫起来："叔詹的计策失败了，楚军还没有撤呢，咱们赶紧逃命吧！"叔詹笑了笑，指着楚营上方说："你们看看，那是什么？""哑——哑——哑——"大家仔细一看，只见许多乌鸦正在楚营上空飞翔，还有几只站在营帐顶上，一动也不动。
page_text_en: The next day, King Wen of Zheng and his ministers arrived at the city wall. They saw the Chu army's camp tents firmly set up, with battle flags flapping in the wind. Terrified, they shouted: "Shu Zhan's plan has failed! The Chu army hasn't retreated yet. Let's flee quickly!" Shu Zhan smiled and pointed above the Chu camp, saying: "Look, what is that?" "Caw—caw—caw—" Everyone looked closely and saw many crows flying above the Chu camp, with a few perched motionless on top of the tents.
summary_zh: 第二天，郑文公和大臣们登上城墙，看到楚军营地整齐，战旗飘扬，误以为计策失败而惊慌，叔詹却指着楚营上空的乌鸦让大家细看，发现乌鸦一动不动，暗示楚军已撤退。

page_text_ocr_zh:
叔詹哈哈大笑道："如果楚营中还有人，乌鸦怎么有这么大胆子呢？楚军早就撤退了，熊子元这是学我们的计策，想用空营吓唬我们呢！"
叔詹的这个守城计策，就是历史上有名的"空城计"。后来，三国时期大名鼎鼎的诸葛亮也用过这个计策。
好计谋！
page_text_en:
Shu Zhan laughed heartily: "If there were still people in the Chu camp, how could the crows be so bold? The Chu army has long retreated. Xiong Ziyuan is imitating our strategy, trying to scare us with an empty camp!"
Shu Zhan's defense strategy is historically known as the "Empty City Strategy." Later, the famous Zhuge Liang of the Three Kingdoms period also used this tactic.
Good strategy!
summary_zh: 郑国大臣叔詹识破楚军已撤退，指出楚营乌鸦不动是空营的迹象，并称赞此计谋为‘空城计’，同时提及诸葛亮也曾使用此计。
